# Fixture — bad status word

`status: nonsense` is not one of `draft | active | closed | retired | superseded`
(NT-0019 §1.2a). No `id:` (Reference carries none), so check 31 has nothing to compare
and stays clean; every other field is exactly `docs/_templates/REFERENCE.md`'s own set.
